notes: Optional ntfy push: Settings configures a host-published ntfy topic (https, optional token, generate/clear topic) and the host sends short approval/question/goal/turn pushes with inbox/session deep links. Also documents the host search budget as best-effort with partial hits. Fake-host push config tests (7) in CI.
